facts.fact: The Herald says all provincial offices, 63 district offices and 206 sub-offices of the Civil Registry Department are fully computerised.
The Herald says more than 20 remote sub-offices were computerised in 2025 with Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation support, including Hauna with UNICEF support.
